name: Technopek Website Backup & Restore
author: Technopek

sections.description:
Technopek Backup packs your database, media, plugins and themes into one file and puts everything back in a few clicks. It is made for site owners: one screen to back up, one screen to restore.

Features

  • Back up the whole site to a single .tpkb file and download it.
  • Send backups straight to your Google Drive.
  • Restore .tpkb backups, and .wpress backups made by other backup tools.
  • Restore from a file you upload, from a backup kept on the server, or from Google Drive.
  • Move a site to a new address or a new host. Links in the database are updated for you, serialized data included.
  • Schedule backups (every few hours, daily, weekly or monthly) with e-mail notices and automatic clean-up of old backups.
  • Incremental backups to Google Drive: after the first full backup, only changed files are uploaded.
  • Protect a backup with a password (AES-256).
  • See the files inside any backup and give backups a short label.
  • Leave out what you do not need: media, plugins, themes, cache, spam comments, post revisions, chosen folders or database tables.

Built for big sites

Long jobs run in short steps and pick up where they stopped, so they do not depend on one long PHP request. Uploads are sent in small pieces, so the upload limit of your host does not matter.

Safe restore

Before a restore changes anything, the plugin checks the file, shows what it contains and asks you to confirm. The database is first imported into temporary tables and then switched over, so a problem during the import never leaves a half-restored database.

External services

This plugin can connect to three external services. Nothing is sent to them unless you connect Google Drive on the plugin’s Google Drive page.

Technopek authorization service

Google requires an app secret to sign in to Google Drive. That secret must not be stored on your site, so the sign-in goes through an authorization service run by Technopek at https://technopek.com/wp-plugin/gdrive.

  • When you click “Link with your Google Drive account”, your browser is sent to the service with the access level (only the files the plugin creates or that you choose), the address of your Google Drive settings page and a one-time security code. The service sends you to Google and, after you accept, back to your site with a Google refresh token.
  • About once an hour, while backups are sent to or read from Google Drive, your site sends the refresh token to the service to get a short-lived access token from Google.
  • When you disconnect, your site sends the refresh token to the service so it can be revoked at Google.

The service does not store your tokens and never receives your backups or any content of your site.

Terms of use: https://technopek.com/fr/mentions-legales
Privacy policy: https://technopek.com/fr/politique-confidentialite

Google Drive API

Once linked, your site talks to the Google Drive API (https://www.googleapis.com) directly, to read your account name, e-mail and storage usage, list the backup folder, and upload, download and delete backup files. Your backups go from your site to your Google Drive and back, never through Technopek.

Google Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
Google APIs Terms of Service: https://developers.google.com/terms

Google Picker

To choose a backup folder or a backup file from anywhere in your Google Drive, the plugin opens the Google Picker, a window run by Google, inside a popup on the Technopek authorization service (https://technopek.com/wp-plugin/gdrive/picker). This only happens when you click “Choose a folder in Google Drive” or “Choose a backup in Google Drive”.

  • Your browser opens that page with your site’s address, and the page loads Google’s script from https://apis.google.com/js/api.js.
  • Your site gives the popup a short-lived access token of your linked account, through the browser only. The token is not sent to or stored on the Technopek server.
  • The popup sends back only the id, name and size of the folder or file you chose, and closes. The plugin then gets access only to what you chose.

The terms and privacy policies of Technopek and Google above apply.
sections.installation:
1. In your admin, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin, search for “Technopek Website Backup & Restore”, then click Install and Activate.
  2. Open “Technopek Backup” in the admin menu.
  3. To make a backup: Import / Export > Export, choose “Download as file” or “Save to Google Drive”, then click Create backup.
  4. To restore: Import / Export > Import, upload a file or pick a backup, then confirm.
  5. To use Google Drive: open the Google Drive page and click “Link with your Google Drive account”.
  6. To back up automatically: open Schedules and click Create schedule.
sections.faq:
Where are my backups stored?

Backups made with “Download as file” are kept in wp-content/tpkb-backups/ until you delete them. The folder is protected from direct web access on Apache and LiteSpeed, and file names contain a random part. On Nginx, ask your host to deny access to that folder. Backups sent to Google Drive are stored in your own Drive.

Will it work on a large site?

Yes. Work is done in short steps, so PHP time limits are not a problem, and transfers are split into pieces. While a backup is being made, you need free disk space for it: roughly the size of your uploads, plugins, themes and database. If uploads to Google Drive fail on a slow host, lower the transfer piece size on the Google Drive page.

Can I restore on a different domain?

Yes. Addresses in the database are replaced with the address of the site you restore on. You can also add your own find-and-replace rules when you export.

What does a restore overwrite?

The database and the files of the site: uploads, plugins and themes. Make a fresh backup first if you are not sure.

Who can use it?

Administrators. Making backups needs the export capability and restoring needs the import capability. You can also lock the Google Drive settings to the administrator who linked the account. The plugin does not run on multisite networks.

Does it send data to third parties?

Only after you link Google Drive. See “External services” above for what is sent and when.

Where is the source code of the admin screens?

The admin screens are written in React with @wordpress/scripts. Their source code is in assets/src/ inside the plugin. To build it, run npm install and then npm run build in the plugin folder.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: Google Drive. Send backups to your Google Drive, restore from it, and schedule Drive backups.
  • New: incremental backups to Google Drive (only what changed is uploaded after the first full backup).
  • New: choose a backup folder or a backup file anywhere in your Google Drive with the Google Picker.
  • The plugin only gets access to the files it creates and the ones you choose.

1.0.0

  • First release.

short_description: Back up, restore and move your WordPress site. Keep backups on your server or in your Google Drive, on demand or on a schedule.
